Plot sample size calculation result

Source: R/plot_sample_size_result.R
plot.sample_size_result.Rd

Draw power curve (sample size vs power) or sample size vs effect size ratio. Requires packages ggplot2 and scales.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'sample_size_result'
plot(x, type = c("power", "sample_size"), ...)

Arguments

x

Object of class sample_size_result from calculate or sample_size_calculator.

type

"power" for sample size vs power; "sample_size" for sample size vs effect size ratio (supported for twoMeans and twoProportions).

...

Passed to downstream methods (currently unused).

Value

Invisibly returns x. A plot is drawn.

Examples

# Antihypertensive RCT planning: check how power scales with enrollment
res <- calculate("rct", "test", "mean", mean1 = 10, mean2 = 12, sd = 3)
plot(res, type = "power")        # sample size vs power curve

# \donttest{
plot(res, type = "sample_size")  # sample size vs effect size

# }
